title: Pais inspired by Steven Greer documentaries

tellings.quote: it was a lot of things that were done by Dr. Steven Greer.

plain: A Navy scientist named Salvatore Pais, known for patents on unusual flying craft, says a lot of what inspired him "was done by Dr. Steven Greer". Greer is a campaigner who wants UFO secrets made public, and the work Pais means is his documentaries Close Encounters of the Fifth Kind and Unacknowledged. Pais says this himself to Michels, and it would mean that UFO films helped shape his work on Navy patents.
